🙏Posebno hoću da zahvalim sestru Natašu za odgovornost, stručnost i ljubaznost. Sve preporuke!

I came to this clinic with severe pain and had to wait over an hour before being seen. The doctor was very friendly and spoke Russian, which I appreciated.

Unfortunately, the rest of the experience was extremely disappointing. The nurse failed to insert the IV needle correctly on the first attempt, and on the second attempt appeared to hit a nerve. Three days later, my right hand is still not functioning normally.

The staff attempted a total of four injections but were unable to administer any medication, claiming that my body was “refusing” the injections. Despite no treatment actually being delivered, I was still billed for it.

I was also prescribed antibiotics without what seemed to be a proper diagnosis or clear explanation for why they were necessary.

Two hours later, I went to another clinic. There, the medical staff inserted the IV on the first attempt without any difficulty, successfully administered the medication, and correctly diagnosed my condition. Antibiotics were not part of the treatment, raising serious doubts about the necessity of the prescription I received at this clinic.

While the doctor was kind, the overall quality of care I received was unacceptable.
The staff here are really kind and thorough. Great service!

Большое спасибо работникам клиники! Мы были на отдыхе. Пришли на приём с подозрением на пневмонию и высокой температурой. Доктор Добрила Никчевич провела осмотр, взяла анализы, сделала грамотное назначение лечения. Уже вечером стало легче. Спасибо большое медицинским сестрам!

Хорошая клиника. Компетентные специалисты, но 4 звезды из за доктора Велимир Милошевич. Нужно клинике пересмотреть цены на его консультации. Потому что за цену одной консультации можно купить подписку на чат gpt  и узнать более точно и получить действительно заинтересованное мнение. Остальные врачи очень хорошие.

Veoma smo razočarani organizacijom rada klinike.

Bili smo naručeni na pregled kod hirurga i posebno smo doputovali iz Bara u Budvu. Tokom puta administratorka je bila u kontaktu s nama i znala je da dolazimo na zakazani pregled.

Kada smo stigli u kliniku, saznali smo da je doktorica već otišla kući. Niko nas nije unaprijed obavijestio o otkazivanju pregleda ili promjeni rasporeda. Zbog toga smo izgubili nekoliko sati na putovanje i ostali bez potrebne medicinske pomoći.

Smatramo da je ovakav odnos prema pacijentima neprihvatljiv. Ako se pregled otkazuje, posebno kada pacijent dolazi iz drugog grada, klinika je dužna da ga blagovremeno obavijesti. Nadamo se da će rukovodstvo obratiti pažnju na ovu situaciju i preduzeti mjere za poboljšanje organizacije rada i odnosa prema pacijentima.
